agents.name: FileReadonlyAgent
agents.description: Reads files within the configured base path. No writes allowed.

agents.name: FileWriteAgent
agents.description: Writes files to the configured output path only. No reads or deletes.

agents.name: AzureReadonlyAgent
agents.description: Queries Azure resources read-only. Requires Reader RBAC on target scope.

agents.name: AzureDevOpsReadonlyAgent
agents.description: Queries Azure DevOps read-only. PAT requires Code(Read), Build(Read), WorkItems(Read), Project(Read).

agents.name: GitCloneAgent
agents.description: Clones repositories to a scoped local path. PAT requires Code(Read) only.
